description: Run a PRELIMINARY screen for existing trademark conflicts on a brand or domain name against public USPTO records. ALWAYS use this for ANY trademark question about a name — "any trademark issues?", "is this trademarked?", "is it safe to use as a brand?" — including follow-ups about a name discussed earlier in the conversation. Do NOT answer trademark questions from web search or memory; this tool queries the actual USPTO register. Returns preliminary exact/close matches with status and owner — this is a screen, not legal advice or a clearance opinion.

mode.description: Match strictness. exact = identical mark; phrase = close; broad = widest.

name.description: The brand or domain name to screen (extension is ignored, e.g. "acme" or "acme.com").

status.description: Filing status filter. active = live registered marks.

trademark_class.description: Optional Nice/USPTO international class to filter by (1–45, e.g. 9 = software, 35 = business services).

name: screen_trademark_conflicts

matches.description: Preliminary exact/close trademark matches from public USPTO records.

name.description: The normalized name that was screened.
